params.name: incident_id
params.description: If provided, only show triggers configured on the service of the given incident. Useful for finding manual triggers that are configured on the service for a specific incident. Cannot be specified if `service_id` is provided.

params.name: service_id
params.description: If provided, only show triggers configured for incidents in the given service. Useful for listing all workflows associated with the given service. Cannot be specified if `incident_id` is provided.

params.name: trigger_type
params.description: If provided, only show triggers of the given type. For example “manual” to search for manual triggers

params.name: workflow_name_contains
params.description: If provided, only show triggers configured to start workflows whose name contain the provided value.
